title: Local-Global
description: This mod adds local and global chat, and removes player nicknames.
body: This plugin revolutionizes in-game communication by introducing two distinct chat modes: local (proximity-based, only audible to players within a configurable radius) and global (broadcast to the entire server regardless of distance). The local chat encourages immersive, realistic interactions between nearby players, while the global channel ensures critical announcements reach everyone. Additionally, the mod completely removes player nicknames from the chat interface and above their heads, replacing them with anonymous identifiers or hiding them altogether. This anonymity is perfect for roleplay servers, hardcore survival modes, or detective-style games where secrecy and suspense are key. Fully configurable—set local chat range, toggle global chat permissions per group, and choose how nicknames are masked (random codes, numbers, or total removal). Compatible with major server cores, no extra libraries required. Enhance your server’s atmosphere and strategic depth today!
